title: Sea to Sky weekend: Nov 27 to 29, 2026
description: What’s on in Whistler, Squamish, Pemberton and Britannia Beach this weekend: both mountains open, the gondola reopens, tree lightings, holiday markets and the North Pole Express.
masthead: Sea to Sky weekend: Nov 27 to 29, 2026
intro: What’s on in Whistler, Squamish, Pemberton and Britannia Beach this weekend: both mountains open, the gondola reopens, tree lightings, holiday markets and the North Pole Express.

entries.name: Whistler Blackcomb: both mountains now open
entries.blurb: Whistler Mountain opened Wed Nov 25, joining Blackcomb (open since Nov 20), with the PEAK 2 PEAK and Creekside Gondola running. Opening terrain includes Emerald 6, Franz’s, Big Red and the Creekside Gondola. Lifts run 9:00 AM–3:30 PM through Jan 15.
warnings: About 105 acres on Whistler Peak stay closed all winter after the 2026 rockslide

entries.name: Train Wreck Winter Hike
entries.venue: Whistler Experience Guide Basecamp, Fairmont Chateau Whistler
entries.blurb: Guided winter hike along the glacier-fed Cheakamus River to the remains of a 1950s train derailment.
badges: Fairmont Chateau guests: advance sign-up required

entries.name: Taylor James après at Dusty’s Bar & BBQ
entries.blurb: Live après set at Creekside; Dusty’s serves breakfast from Friday, and the season’s first Country Night follows Friday evening.

entries.name: Hairfarmers at Merlin’s
entries.blurb: The Whistler band plays the opening-week Friday après.

entries.name: C.R. Avery’s East Van Abbey Cabaret
entries.venue: The Point Artist-Run Centre, 5678 Alta Lake Rd
entries.blurb: Harmonica, spoken word and heartfelt songs with a five-piece band, featured songwriters, poets and a dancer; cash/card bar. $25 (the $20 advance price ended Nov 14/15).

sources.label: thepointartists.com: C.R. Avery’s East Van Abbey Cabaret

warnings: Venue says doors 7 PM / show 8 PM: aggregators list 6 PM

entries.name: Sea to Sky Gondola reopens
entries.blurb: Back from annual maintenance (closed Nov 16–26) with Spirit of the Season under way. Daily hours 9 AM–5 PM, last ride down 6 PM. Adult $73.95 online / $81.95 at the window; youth 13–18 $43.95 / $51.95; child 6–12 $29.95 / $37.95; under 6 free.

entries.name: Photos with Santa at the Summit
entries.venue: Summit Lodge, Sea to Sky Gondola
entries.blurb: Pre-booked Santa photos at the summit. $30 for one photo; gondola ticket extra. Also Saturday and Sunday.

sources.label: whistlerroam.com: Photos with Santa at the Summit

entries.name: Storytime at the Library
entries.blurb: Free half-hour of stories, songs and rhymes: family storytime at 10:30 AM, baby storytime at 11:30 AM. Regular Tue/Fri/Sat program.

entries.name: Pokémon Drop-In
entries.blurb: Card trading and play for kids about 6–14. $15.

entries.name: Board Game Drop-in (adults only)
entries.blurb: Evening board games for adults. $15.

entries.name: Kirtan and Potluck
entries.blurb: Community chanting evening with a shared potluck.

entries.name: Surf Hat (Night 1)
entries.venue: Brackendale Art Gallery, 41950 Government Rd, Squamish
entries.blurb: Squamish cold-water surf rock with opener Jean Jacket. $30 advance / $35 door. Also Saturday.
warnings: Listed as sold out in places, and the start time varies by source (7–9 PM). Check before going

entries.name: BASSTACHE: A Dubstep Movember Fundraiser
entries.blurb: Dubstep and bass night on the Lost Signal Sound System with Calamity, Cyborq, DSAV and Hugh Mungus. $10 / $15 / $20.

entries.name: Britannia Village Christmas Tree Lighting
entries.blurb: Free. Carollers (Sunshine Choir and Monika Macias, 5–6 PM), hot drinks, kids’ activities, the first Holiday Makers Market of the season, and the Britannia Beach Fire Department’s vintage fire truck.
warnings: Village Instagram lists 4–8 PM; tree lighting at 6 PM on all sources

entries.name: PAC Movie Night: “HOME” (the Whistler Blackcomb movie)
entries.venue: Signal Hill Elementary Gym, Portage Rd, Pemberton
entries.blurb: Family ski-film fundraiser for the PAC, with swag giveaways (Oyuki, Whistler Blackcomb, HEAD) and Grade 7 snack sales. Bring cash. $5 at the door; students must be accompanied by an adult.

entries.name: Arts Whistler Holiday Market (Day 1)
entries.blurb: 100+ BC artisan stalls (food and drink, fine art, jewellery, ceramics and apparel) plus the Bratz Biz young-entrepreneur market. $5; kids under 16 free. Also Sunday.

entries.name: Holiday Family Portraits
entries.blurb: Pre-holiday family portraits at the Chateau.
badges: Fairmont Chateau guests: advance sign-up required

entries.name: Squamish Mamquam Parkrun
entries.blurb: Free, volunteer-run timed 5 km on a flat gravel double loop; walkers welcome. Regular weekly run.

entries.name: Photos with Santa at the Summit
entries.venue: Summit Lodge, Sea to Sky Gondola
entries.blurb: Pre-booked Santa photos at the summit. $30 for one photo; gondola ticket extra. Also Friday and Sunday.

sources.label: whistlerroam.com: Photos with Santa at the Summit

entries.name: Squamish Farmers’ Winter Market
entries.venue: 37996 Cleveland Ave, downtown next to Junction Park
entries.blurb: Local farmers, food makers, crafts and buskers; the winter market runs Saturdays to Dec 19.

entries.name: Sea to Sky Potters’ Guild Holiday Pottery Sale
entries.blurb: Holiday pottery sale from the local potters’ guild.

entries.name: Create-mas Squamish Holiday Market
entries.blurb: Holiday market from local makers.

entries.name: North Pole Express (Day 1)
entries.venue: Railway Museum of BC, 39645 Government Rd
entries.blurb: Christmas train ride with onboard entertainment, cookies and a visit with Santa and Mrs. Claus. Bronze $48.76, Silver $55.12, Gold $60.95, Platinum $75.26 per seat; arrive 1 hour before departure. Also Sunday.
badges: Limited-release 35% off Bronze & Platinum for Nov 28–29 departures bought within 48 hours

entries.name: Christmas Tree Lighting at the Summit
entries.venue: Summit Lodge & Backyard Plaza, Sea to Sky Gondola
entries.blurb: Live music from Doug & Jane, Sea to Sky Singers carols 4:30–5:30 PM, Santa helps light the tree, plus a fire, food and drink specials and a kids’ craft table. Free with lift ticket or membership.
warnings: Explore Squamish lists 3–5 PM; tree lighting at 5 PM on all sources

entries.name: Nearly Neil (Neil Diamond tribute)
entries.blurb: Neil Diamond tribute night at the Legion. $25.

entries.name: Surf Hat (Night 2)
entries.venue: Brackendale Art Gallery, 41950 Government Rd, Squamish
entries.blurb: Second night of the Squamish cold-water surf rock band, with opener Jean Jacket. $30 advance / $35 door.
warnings: Listed as sold out in places; start time varies by source. Check before going

entries.name: Bobcaygeon: A Tribute to The Tragically Hip
entries.blurb: Vancouver tribute band playing the Hip’s catalogue. $20 / $25.

entries.name: Arts Whistler Holiday Market (Day 2)
entries.blurb: Second day of the holiday market: 100+ BC artisan stalls plus the Bratz Biz young-entrepreneur market. $5; kids under 16 free.

entries.name: Letters to Santa
entries.blurb: Festive family workshop: write a letter to Santa with hot chocolate, creative stationery and holiday keepsakes.
badges: Fairmont Chateau guests: advance sign-up required

entries.name: Holiday Card Writing
entries.blurb: Complimentary cards and postage for holiday greetings.
badges: Fairmont Chateau guests: advance sign-up required

entries.name: Squamish Dance Centre Holiday Craft Fair
entries.blurb: Holiday craft fair from local makers.

entries.name: Board Game Drop-in (with game host)
entries.blurb: Sunday board games with a host to teach the games. $15.

entries.name: Britannia Village Holiday Makers Market
entries.venue: Britannia Village, 101 Church St, Britannia Beach
entries.blurb: Weekly Sunday makers market, running through the season.
warnings: Hours per an event roundup: not confirmed on the village’s own page

entries.name: Robbie Johnson Live at The Backyard
entries.blurb: Free Sunday set of classic country and contemporary folk, in the Johnny Cash / Corb Lund vein.

entries.name: Sunday Night Football
entries.blurb: Sunday night games on the big screens with the full sound system and three projectors: the weekly football watch at Trickster’s.

entries.name: Carol’s Carols
entries.venue: Brackendale Art Gallery, 41950 Government Rd, Squamish
entries.blurb: Free community carol singing at the BAG.

entries.name: SantaPAWS
entries.blurb: Holiday photos with Santa for pets (and their people); annual fundraiser for the Pemberton Animal Well-Being Society.
warnings: No price listed on the source

entries.name: Market at the Helmers Farm Stand: Stock up for Winter
entries.venue: Helmers Organic Farm, 8409 Pemberton Meadows Rd
entries.blurb: Farm stand market to stock up for winter.

entries.name: Whistler Winterlight
entries.blurb: Ferris wheel (50+ ft, lit): Fri/Sat 12–8 PM, Sun 12–5 PM, $5/ride. Free evening programming Fri/Sat 5–8 PM: Converge laser installation, glowing archways, live DJs, Berzerkatroid the fire-breathing dragon, Firefly Forest, shadow puppets, illuminated characters and a pop-up market. Outdoor skating daily in three sessions (11 AM–1:30 PM, 2:30–5 PM, 6–8:30 PM): adult $6.25, youth $5.25, child $3.75, skate rental $7.25. Free entry to the Plaza.

entries.name: Spirit of the Season, Sea to Sky Gondola
entries.blurb: Decorated Spirit Trail forest walk daily, plus a guided Forest Walking Tour daily 12–1 PM and a Twilight Tour daily 4–5 PM (headlamp); Santa photos on select dates. Included with gondola admission.

entries.name: Ore & Orcas: Howe Sound / Átl’ḵa7tsem, A Recovering Ecosystem
entries.venue: Britannia Mine Museum, Terra Lab: open daily 9:00 AM–4:30 PM
entries.blurb: Temporary exhibit on Howe Sound’s recovering marine ecosystem, including a real killer-whale skeleton, plus the new Handmade Histories display of Britannia scrapbooks and photo albums (Nov 16 – Jan 4).

notes: Confirm before you go. Times were researched on Nov 25, 2026 from the source pages linked above. Check the event pages directly before heading out, especially listings marked with time warnings.

Events without stated times were listed on their source calendars with no start time given; those marked “unconfirmed” had conflicting times across sources. Lions Bay, Horseshoe Bay and Furry Creek had no verified events this weekend. The Sea to Sky Gondola reopens Friday, Nov 27, after annual maintenance.
